channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Saks is closing dozens of Off 5th and Last Call locations. Here's the full list.
item.description: As part of its restructuring, the bankrupt Saks Global is doubling down on luxury and closing down many Off 5th and Last Call locations.

item.title: I'm trying to guess why Elon Musk wants to mash SpaceX into xAI — or Tesla. I'm stumped.
item.description: Elon Musk's companies already share employees, resources and investors. Maybe a possible merger of SpaceX and xAI — or Tesla — would simplify things.

item.title: The sole federal regulator over prediction markets says it's easing off
item.description: CFTC chairman Michael Selig said the agency would reverse previous statements on prediction markets, write new rules, and speak up in lawsuits.

item.title: Judge greenlights Epstein victims' sex-trafficking lawsuit against Bank of America
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein's victims have accused Bank of America of facilitating Jeffrey Epstein's sex-trafficking operation.

item.title: Judge urges MrBeast to avoid a trial over his burger business and keep his 'dirty laundry' private
item.description: In a hearing, a judge advised YouTuber Jimmy Donaldson and Virtual Dining Concepts to settle their legal dispute over MrBeast Burger.

item.title: The founder of First Brands, whose bankruptcy rattled Wall Street, charged in multibillion-dollar fraud
item.description: First Brands' bankruptcy leads to fraud charges for founder Patrick James and his brother Edward. A third former executive has pleaded guilty.

item.title: A shortage in memory chips is hitting tech hard, and even Apple's not immune
item.description: Apple CEO Tim Cook says a global memory chip shortage is beginning to bite, with rising costs expected to pressure margins ahead.

item.title: Chelsea Handler, 50, says she took parenting classes — even though she doesn't have kids
item.description: "It's not that I don't have a maternal instinct. I do, I just don't want children," Chelsea Handler said.

item.title: Medium says employees can join Friday's strike against ICE: 'Our business thrives when the country thrives'
item.description: The company's CEO wrote to employees that "sometimes it feels awkward to navigate being both on-mission and on-money."

item.title: I stopped making New Year's resolutions. I take a trip first — then reset my life in February.
item.description: In previous years, Sinead Mulhern had set ambitious goals on January 1, only to abandon them weeks later.
